layout.widthNote: Conservative 6 m racing corridor within an original asymmetric bank and apron reconstruction. Physical extents are pinned in pavement-sections.json; estimated from NAIP imagery, not an official pavement survey.

layout.bankingNote: Original game reconstruction uses documented 31 degree turns, 18 degree tri-oval and 3 degree backstretch angles, native ground anchors and authored transition locations. It is not a surveyed engineering alignment.
